groups.name: campus.rag
groups.description: RAG retrieval, chunking, and reranking settings.

groups.name: campus.memory
groups.description: Short, medium, long-term, and fact memory settings.

properties.name: campus.security.jwt-secret
properties.description: HMAC secret used to sign JWT tokens. Use a private value in local environment files.

properties.name: campus.security.token-ttl-minutes
properties.description: JWT token lifetime in minutes.

properties.name: campus.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Allowed browser origins.

properties.name: campus.vector.datasource.jdbc-url
properties.description: JDBC URL for the PostgreSQL pgvector database.

properties.name: campus.vector.datasource.username
properties.description: Username for the PostgreSQL pgvector database.

properties.name: campus.vector.datasource.password
properties.description: Password for the PostgreSQL pgvector database. Prefer environment variables in real deployments.

properties.name: campus.vector.datasource.driver-class-name
properties.description: JDBC driver class for the pgvector datasource.

properties.name: campus.vector.dimensions
properties.description: Embedding vector dimensions used by the pgvector table.

properties.name: campus.vector.initialize-schema
properties.description: Whether to let Spring AI initialize the pgvector schema.

properties.name: campus.upload.max-characters
properties.description: Maximum characters accepted for a text material upload.

properties.name: campus.rag.chunk-size
properties.description: Maximum characters per text chunk before embedding.

properties.name: campus.rag.chunk-overlap
properties.description: Overlapped characters between adjacent chunks.

properties.name: campus.rag.top-k
properties.description: Final number of RAG chunks injected into the answer prompt.

properties.name: campus.rag.candidate-k
properties.description: Number of vector candidates retrieved before reranking.

properties.name: campus.rag.similarity-threshold
properties.description: Minimum vector similarity threshold for candidate retrieval.

properties.name: campus.rag.rerank-enabled
properties.description: Whether lightweight local reranking is enabled.

properties.name: campus.rag.vector-weight
properties.description: Weight of vector score in lightweight reranking.

properties.name: campus.rag.lexical-weight
properties.description: Weight of lexical overlap score in lightweight reranking.

properties.name: campus.rag.reranker-model
properties.description: DashScope reranker model name.

properties.name: campus.rag.reranker-endpoint
properties.description: DashScope OpenAI-compatible rerank endpoint.

properties.name: campus.rag.reranker-instruction
properties.description: Instruction passed to the reranker model.

properties.name: campus.rag.reranker-timeout-seconds
properties.description: HTTP timeout for the external reranker call.

properties.name: campus.rag.local-rerank-fallback
properties.description: Whether to fallback to lightweight local reranking if external reranking is unavailable.

properties.name: campus.memory.short-term-ttl-minutes
properties.description: Redis TTL for short-term session memory.

properties.name: campus.memory.short-term-max-messages
properties.description: Maximum short-term memory messages retained per session.

properties.name: campus.memory.summary-max-characters
properties.description: Maximum characters retained in medium-term conversation summaries.

properties.name: campus.memory.fact-default-ttl-days
properties.description: Default expiration period for user fact memories.
